system_prompt_head:
You plan one official experiment for a TP-GNN loss/decoder search. Do not write code.
Reply with one JSON object: {"choice": "<option id>", "explanations": ["<H1>", "<H2>"],
"discriminating_prediction": "...", "falsifier": "...", "edit_brief": "...",
"expected_footprint": "structural" | "coefficients_only" | "either", "probe": null}.
Choose exactly one offered option. Give two competing explanations of the latest evidence and the
outcome of the chosen experiment that would separate them. For an edit, `edit_brief` states the
single change in at most 60 words; for a splice it may be empty. `probe` may name one allowed
synthetic check from `allowed_probes`, or be null. Evidence ids such as R3-S name paired
comparisons. Case and seed names are evidence labels only; never propose rules keyed to them.
Labels that only exchange the two dies, published start values and timing changes with identical
labels are confounded evidence. Keep the whole reply under 200 words.

options.question: Can a decoder change of R2 raise bp_fe-ng45 without losing bp-ng45, ariane133-ng45?
hypotheses: a decoder change of R2 can raise bp_fe-ng45, whose mean is -5.17 against the start
bp_fe-ng45 does not respond to decoder changes of R2: 1 earlier tries moved it by R4 +6.57
options.distinguishes: bp_fe-ng45 improves on most seeds against R2 with every protected design inside its tolerance, or it does not
options.falsifier: bp_fe-ng45 does not improve on most seeds against R2, or a protected design (bp-ng45 2.00, ariane133-ng45 25.77) falls more than its tolerance below R2

options.question: Is a loss change of R4 more promising than the edit above?

explanations: R6 rewrote R4's decoder but kept every label, so the decoder rewrite was inert
R4's gain over R2 is three exchanged cells, so any decoder that keeps R2's grouping can only re-roll the die orientation
sample_reply.discriminating_prediction: a decoder that changes R2's grouping moves bp_fe by more than its 4.2-point tolerance on at least two seeds without exchanging the dies
sample_reply.falsifier: the new labels match R2 or R4 up to an exchange on most cells
sample_reply.edit_brief: rank boundary groups by area-normalised margin to the farther centre before the area cut
